Commands

  • Run R from the console with --quiet --vanilla
  • Format: air format after generating or editing R code, but only format modified files, do not format the entire directory/pkg
  • Test all: devtools::test()
  • Test one file: devtools::test_file("tests/testthat/test-filename.R")
  • Never use devtools::test_active_file() — it doesn’t work in this setup
  • Full check: devtools::check()
  • Docs: devtools::document() after any roxygen2 change, then pkgdown::check_pkgdown() to confirm every topic is in the reference index
  • Load for interactive dev: devtools::load_all()

Conventions

  • Tests for R/{name}.R go in tests/testthat/test-{name}.R; fixtures in tests/testthat/fixtures/; snapshots in tests/testthat/_snaps/.
  • Line width 120 (.lintr); no object_usage_linter/object_name_linter/object_length_linter/return_linter.
  • Don’t edit man/ — generated by roxygen2.
  • Sentence case for all headings, in docs and roxygen.
  • For PRs, check that the version number in DESCRIPTION has been bumped
  • Project uses MegaLinter cspell. Keep inst/WORDLIST sorted with LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 sort -o inst/WORDLIST inst/WORDLIST after adding entries
